description: EC2 Instance Absent From AWS Backup Protected Resource Inventory — Review
rationale: In the selected Region, AWS Backup ListProtectedResources completed and did not return an exact ARN for this non-stopped EC2 instance. This is only an AWS Backup evidence gap: DLM, native EBS snapshots, AMIs, other backup services, restore success and cross-account copies are not established.
remediation: Verify documented EC2 recovery-point and restore strategy; consider AWS Backup resource protection, DLM or tested native EBS/AMI recovery with target RPO/RTO.
